Channeling the Force grants you the following:

  • You can apply your Stunning Strike feature to a ranged weapon attack hit made with a Whills weapon.
  • You may spend up to 3 focus points to reduce a target's partial cover by one step (three-quarters to half, or half to one-quarter); reducing it below one-quarter removes cover bonuses entirely. At 17th level, spending 3 focus points instead lets you ignore total cover as long as the target isn't hidden from you.
  • Hitting a creature with a Whills weapon gives it disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you until the start of your next turn.
